title: X-AgentRed: Red-Teaming Personal Agents in Evolving Multi-Service Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2610.13886v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal agents increasingly connect to services across the web and applications by using tools. As the effects of their actions accumulate and interact across services, unintended or harmful outcomes can arise when agents fulfill benign user requests. Proactively identifying these compositional failures requires systematically exploring diverse cross-service paths. Existing red-teaming methods often simply prompt LLMs to identify potentially harmful paths from task and environment descriptions or decompose harmful objectives specified by humans or LLMs into seemingly benign action combinations. However, generation is biased toward patterns learned during training, potentially favoring familiar tool combinations and leaving novel cross-service interactions underexplored. translated_title: X-AgentRed：在不断演化的多服务生态系统中对个人智能体进行红队测试
translated_abstract: 个人智能体日益通过使用工具连接到网络和应用程序中的各类服务。随着其行动的效果在各个服务之间累积并相互作用，智能体在完成良性的用户请求时可能会产生非预期或有害的结果。主动识别这些组合性失败需要系统地探索多样化的跨服务路径。现有的红队测试方法通常只是简单地提示大语言模型从任务和环境描述中识别潜在的有害路径，或者将人类或大语言模型指定的有害目标分解为看似良性的行动组合。然而，这种生成方式偏向于训练期间学习到的模式，可能倾向于使用熟悉的工具组合，导致新颖的跨服务交互未被充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了X-AgentRed，这是一个自进化的红队测试框架，它通过工具依赖图来发现有害的工具调用路径，并扩展和……
tldr: 提出X-AgentRed，一个自进化的红队测试框架，通过工具依赖图系统性地发现多服务生态系统中个人智能体的有害工具调用路径，克服了现有方法偏向熟悉工具组合、忽略新颖跨服务交互的局限。
en_tdlr: Proposes X-AgentRed, a self-evolving red-teaming framework that discovers harmful tool call paths through a tool dependency graph, overcoming existing methods' bias toward familiar tool combinations and enabling systematic exploration of novel cross-service interactions in multi-service agent ecosystems.
